name: semanticscript
description: Agent-first SemanticScript toolchain: compile, lint, and analyze .sem source through stable JSON surfaces.
long_description: Exposes the SemanticScript `sem` CLI's stable JSON surfaces (bootstrap, project agent docs, skills, help, docs_search/docs_get, check, readiness, context, symbols, graph, slice, explain, fix plan, patch, test, and more) as MCP tools, backed by the bundled single-file `sem` executable. First call agent_docs {"path":"."} when project instructions exist; then skills_get {"names":["sem-start","sem","sem-agent","sem-syntax"]}; then call help {"path":"."}; use docs_search for capability/API/type/syntax/runtime discovery before generating stdlib calls.
